description:
## Goal

Make InputFlowRelation the one finite, typed authority for correlated local semantic observations. It must retain what complete value is observed, where it is observed, and under which equality conditions it is reached. Direct-call operands cross together in real frames. AssertSame remains a predicate over values; it never recursively redefines either value.

A consumer must never Cartesianize independent columns, recover information omitted at publication, confuse impossibility with absence or a product unit, or let construction history, traversal order, display text, or incidental IDs decide meaning.

## Proven defects

The predecessor stores independent direct-call input columns. Coherent frames {(a,b),(c,d)} and crossed frames {(a,d),(c,b)} collapse to one fact. Local constants disappear, so same(x,:hit) and same(x,:miss) retain equal relations.

Independent LoweredStep matches omitted lambda captures, dynamic bitstring sizes, BitstringRead outputs, and multi-output definitions. Generic definition/read consumers duplicated the opcode inventory. Map semantic classification used repeated suffix scans and consumers normalized already normalized exclusions.

Cold reviews established these additional laws:

- A fully overwritten map-update base is a no-contribution product unit, not an impossible alternative; deleting it must not annihilate a surviving replacement or branch choice.
- No transfer records cannot mean both an impossible alternative sum and an empty simultaneous product. Complete nullary values are not absence.
- Whole-prefix list construction tags lose exact suffixes and distinguish [x] from [x | []]. Lists require recursive cons/empty denotations at exact tail paths.
- Map remainder removes only the replaced base-root map shell; nested denotations at untouched keys survive.
- A standalone call-result contribution duplicates the delivered CallsiteReturn alternative and collides when the tail result and resume share an SSA value. Direct returns already own their CallResult observation.
- Eager AssertSame alias substitution manufactures recursive value definitions. It can memoize a provisional cut as a unit, make frames depend on argument order, or generate the unbounded path equation A = origin + field(A).
- Expanding aliases only once is finite but loses structural consequences; unbounded saturation has no termination proof. Equality must be retained as an observation, not used as definition substitution.
- Attaching conditions only to delivered values or intersecting them at merges loses branch conditions when the delivery is unused. Conditions belong to control alternatives and every observation reached through them.
- Equal opaque dependency descriptions do not prove equal runtime values. Repeated and distinct operand roles must remain explicit.
- Combining singleton contribution products by cloning the accumulated prefix makes an unbranched n-field tuple or map perform quadratic term/path copies for linear output.

## Correct-by-construction retained model

InputFlowRelation keeps its callsite-indexed direct-call map and replaces flattened per-origin flows with complete observations:

```text
InputFlowRelation {
  local_dispatch,
  direct_calls[callsite] = { callee, frames },
  observations = { Value { sink, value, when }, Equal { operands, when } }
}

frame = { operands, roles, when }
```

One SemanticValue carrier is used by call operands, returns, protocol inputs, callable uses, equality operands, and conditions. Its typed terms retain exact Input or CallResult origins with paths, normalized local denotations, or a conservative opaque value with the complete flattened set of exact operands it may read. Opaque is dependency knowledge, not expression equality.

Value sinks are only Return, ProtocolInput{callee,input}, or Callable(site). Semantic terms already own their destination paths, so sinks do not duplicate them. A direct-call return is a Return observation of the exact CallResult(callsite). Protocol forwarding is an unconditional exact Input observation. Constants and complete locally constructed values remain observations even when they have no input origin.

Every direct-call frame owns the whole positional operand tuple plus one correlated condition set. A zero-argument call has one empty frame. A canonical positional role partition distinguishes repeated and separately supplied operands without retaining ValueId:

```text
same(z,z) -> values=[meaning(z)], roles=[0,0]
same(a,b) -> values=[meaning(a),meaning(b)], roles=[0,1]
```

Classes are numbered by first positional occurrence, never ValueId order. Exact normalized values may coalesce only when equality is proved by their typed denotation. Equal-looking opaque meanings remain distinct roles unless the same transient source supplied both.

EqualityOperands is Repeated(value) or symmetric Pair([left,right]). Operand swap canonicalizes by typed value comparison and retains Pair when two opaque descriptions compare equal. Conditions are flat sorted conjunctions of equality observations; alternative sets are disjunction. Equality operands contain bare SemanticValues, never recursively conditioned values. Transient control/merge choices preserve compatible branches and disappear before publication.

AssertSame emits an Equal observation at its execution point and adds that equality to the successful outgoing control context. One topological traversal unions complete incoming condition alternatives at merges; it does not replace them with their intersection. Conditions travel even when a delivered value is unused, and producer conditions stay correlated with delivered alternatives, calls, returns, and callable observations. Original acyclic SSA definitions resolve independently of equality. No equality-derived structural paths, alias fixpoint, dependency cut, depth budget, or private solver exists.

The local value algebra distinguishes:

- missing definition: explicit conservative unknown;
- Alternatives(empty): defined impossible additive zero;
- Contributions(empty): simultaneous multiplicative unit retaining choices;
- complete value: at least one explicit typed denotation or opaque term.

Delivered resumes begin as Alternatives(empty) and union real deliveries. Projection or embedding may erase contribution terms without erasing the surviving unit or choices. Only incompatible choices eliminate an alternative. ValueTransfer never mixes simultaneous contributions with alternative sums.

Typed local denotations preserve observable value identity: literal runtime denotation, tuple arity, ListCons/EmptyList at exact tail paths, map, Struct(ModuleId), bitstring with constructed empty normalized to Binary([]), and Callable{FunctionId,CallableValueKind}. They never use source spelling, rendered names, opcode strings, ValueId, ControlEntryId, raw Ty order, or interner history. Structural children remain ordinary path contributions. Source projection and result embedding reuse InputPathStep and compose_paths. A map remainder discards only the old root Map shell; untouched nested denotations follow the same path algebra.

LoweredStep owns one exhaustive allocation-free typed role authority. Every variant and field is destructured without catch-all fields. Definitions enter no aggregate loop. Reads visit raw operands once without semantic classification. Semantics emits definitions, denotations, structural/whole contributions, callables/captures, and equality observations. Map reads are one forward pass. Map semantics is one reverse ordered-set pass and alone owns last-writer, dynamic exclusion, and remainder meaning. The retained selector copies its sorted unique exclusions directly.

Capture endpoints are collected during the necessary semantic pass and resolved after original definitions and control contexts are available. Extraction never rescans all steps or reclassifies maps solely to find captures.

Contribution products consume owned alternatives. Zero and singleton paths move/extend their accumulator; accumulated prefixes are copied only to produce real additional branches after compatibility checks. Canonical BTreeSet insertion remains O(log n), but unbranched product assembly performs no growing-prefix clones.

The production derivation emits deterministic StepValueWork: operand entries visited, map entries classified, normalized-key operations, exclusion members emitted, compatible products emitted, and logical prefix terms copied for branch fanout. The raw telemetry boundary is typed and JSONL-registered; no proof-only counter is computed and discarded.

## Safe boundary before fz-kdt.200

The current coarse InputDemand cannot represent relational equality, but it consumes this sole fact soundly without another store or equality solver:

- Value(Return) applies returned demand to the SemanticValue.
- Value(ProtocolInput) applies the matching callee-input demand.
- Callable observations remain available to the existing callable consumer without inventing new InputDemand meaning.
- A live conditioned value or call conservatively asks Whole of every exact origin in its conditions.
- Dispatch mode seeds every Equal observation and its prior conditions, so AssertSame(x,y) followed by a constant or Halt cannot disappear.
- Repeated equality may reduce only when repetition is proved; an opaque Pair remains an observation.

This is a direct projection visitor over InputFlowRelation. It never materializes compatibility edges or performs equality closure. fz-kdt.200 replaces the coarse projection with normalized relational QuestionTemplate substitution over the same conditions and positional roles.

## TDD

1. RED on the clean predecessor: coherent/crossed frames and hit/miss constants collapse. After cutover all remain distinct.
2. Every LoweredStep result/read field is covered: captures, dynamic bit sizes, all BitstringRead outputs, multi-output definitions, and opaque operands survive the production boundary.
3. Full and partial map overwrites retain only real replacements and branch choices. Updating b preserves a nested empty map at untouched a and normalizes with direct construction.
4. Alternative algebra distinguishes missing, impossible sum, empty product unit, complete nullary value, and explicit opaque unknown. Delivered impossibility yields zero frames; missing alone yields one unknown.
5. Empty tuple/list/map and constructed empty bitstring have correct distinct normalized denotations. Struct module and callable target/kind survive at every arity. Capture-free closure and function reference remain typed distinct.
6. SplitList tail([x]) equals EmptyList. [x] equals [x | []]. A zero-prefix improper list equals its tail. Longer tail projections remain closed.
7. AssertSame cycle witnesses remain finite and traversal-order independent without generated path towers: x; t={x}; p=t[0]; p==x; consume(x,t), plus x==field(x,0) and mutual structural equations.
8. t={x}; t==y; consume(y[0]) retains y[0] as the value and the separate equality observation relating y to t. It never recursively rewrites either definition.
9. Branch deliveries preserve exact per-arm conditions without cross-arm leakage. A discarded delivered constant followed by return/capture of an outer value retains Eq(x,a) OR Eq(x,b). AssertSame followed by a constant return or Halt remains an intrinsic observation.
10. Eq(z,z) differs from Eq(a,b) when opaque dependency descriptions compare equal. Equality swap, call operand repetition, source/control renumbering, and arrival permutations yield canonical typed identity.
11. Two same-callee callsites never borrow conditions or results. Zero arguments produces one empty frame. Delivered call results work when tail result and resume share the SSA identity; direct returns retain exact CallResult observations without a parallel definition.
12. Work counts prove Definitions n-map 0/0, Reads n/0, Semantics exactly n classifications and n normalized-key operations. Capture discovery causes no second pass. Unbranched n and 2n tuple/map products report zero prefix clones; branch copying is charged only to distinct outputs.
13. Equal publication retains allocation/revision and wakes nobody. Replacement retracts only obsolete frames/observations. Cross-process content is byte-identical.
14. The composition fixture drives dynamic bit size through constructed bits, a captured closure, and a direct call on interp, run, and build.

Every semantic defect witness fails through the relevant production boundary on its predecessor before the model changes.

## Required deletion and boundaries

Delete independent DirectCallFlow columns; flattened per-origin InputFlow edges; duplicated sink paths; AliasMap/AliasPairs/closure; equality-dependent value resolution; provisional cycle cuts; ValueTransfer::Resolved and mixed transfer vectors; the standalone call-result contribution loop; the input_flow opcode match; duplicate generic result/read inventories; duplicate capture scans; map-specific literal identity; suffix scans; consumer re-normalization; borrowed growing-product cloning; compatibility edges; proof-only probes; and obsolete tests/docs.

Leave no frame side table, equality side store, second fact, display classifier, raw-id order, private equality fixpoint, depth/traversal budget, timing threshold, or migration debris. Policy-specific semantic typing, codegen, and runtime_demand callable escape analysis remain separate unless their own production witness authorizes convergence. Replacing ExprStep or introducing a macro-generated instruction schema is outside this ticket.

This ticket corrects the retained relation boundary landed by fz-kdt.214 and blocks fz-kdt.200. fz-kdt.200 owns QuestionTemplate/domain/solver and exact relational substitution; it must not rebuild equality or role correlation. fz-kdt.188 separately removes fabricated Cartesian ActivationInputRow after semantic coalescing. Closed fz-kdt.81 and fz-1ah.8 cover different retained authorities.

## Acceptance

The retained fact has one finite typed meaning: values/calls/assertions plus the exact condition alternative under which each is observed. Equivalent denotations normalize identically. No eager alias equation, Cartesian product, consumer recovery, duplicate scan/store, or construction debris survives. Current consumers remain sound; fz-kdt.200 can consume exact relational observations without recovering lost identity.

Focused role, extraction, path, frame, equality, work, publication, and replacement tests; serial library; serial fixture matrix; all three target doors; cross-process determinism; docs/audit; cargo check; strict clippy; formatting; and diff checks pass. A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review accepts the final frozen diff before its one commit and close.
title: Preserve correlated semantic observations in InputFlowRelation
